notes.title: Ashes ~Queen Of Victory
notes.notes:
[b]Introducing Ashes
~Queen Of Victory[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952336/6369ec23f07b55d64f70198fbfe90bb0cbd7ce16.png[/img]

Ashes is a Support, Fighter character inspired by vampires of old. Being a support means she deals less damage then DPS characters, although she brings important buffs that increase your damage amount. One buff being the new Life Feast Buff (increases damage based off of remaining hp with a minimum of 10% and a maximum of 50%), finally her last buff being a penetration increase buff. Ashes also has crazy movement and self lifesteal, allowing her to get in and out of any situation with ease.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952336/0e2d253f51bca2a0a70e69a6268565676e76bb63.gif[/img]

With Ashes a new heavy weapon "Glissen" will be in chapter 2. Glissen is a battle axe with slow, short attacks. However, these attacks will melt anything that touches. With the new title system which will be discussed later on Glissen and other heavy weapons will prove to be useful in many situations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952336/ed4bf020a5a1fb8177efb91d301f9eab984e1495.gif[/img]

Ashes along with the next future characters will be released with the Chapter 2 update.

/PS: On release the actual weapon will have fewer particle effects, or animation changes.

notes.title: Soul ~Queen Of Loss
notes.notes:
[b]Introducing Soul
~Queen Of Hearts[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952336/cb69cff4e988a1a1f8339482a1ec02e7705a82bd.jpg[/img]

Soul is a Hybrid, Charge character who's focused more on defense and range. Through mastery of her signature weapon "Glide" she is able to attack from insanely long distances, or keep up amazing pressure on enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952336/f2eaefc1f0cf3e5e4088e52c92e811cc91460f5e.gif[/img]

Along with Soul, her signature weapon Glide will also be useable by all units. Glide is a primarily projectile focused weapon that's great at defense or proccing projectile based Titles and effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952336/517854a9dcca6652b0e336b470e9526804f4a533.gif[/img]

Soul along with the next future characters will be released with the Chapter 2 update.

/PS: On release the actual weapon will have fewer particle effects, or animation changes.

notes.title: Small Balance Update
notes.notes:
~In case you missed the announcement this small patch is for the following:

~For the first 3 story missions enemy stats will be adjusted from 1 to 0.5, and bosses will be adjusted from 1 to 0.75. This means they will deal 50% of current attack power and have 50% of health for normal enemies.

~Credits received for these first 3 story missions will also be reduced by 50%

notes.title: Future Update
Balance Patch
Cutscenes... Finally
notes.notes:
Finally finished all of the pictures for all of the 1st chapters cutscenes. 

(At the moment this will only be towards the main game and not the demo version. After the next update which will focus on rebalancing and small fixes, the demo version will be brought up to the same version as that will be the last update for said demo version.)

notes.title: Important Update
notes.notes:
This patch includes the following:

~Bug fixes

~Graphical changes as described in the future plans notice

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952336/51c7bd31a9a6a641e173ea547f8e747b51d44985.gif[/img]

The next update will take awhile, but will include (possibly more bug fixes) and cutscenes.

notes.title: Future Plans
notes.notes:
For future content I'll be breaking it down into smaller updates, to speed up the process and stay organized. The following content is planned for the upcoming future in the order listed.

1: Bug fixes: At the moment there's few bugs that still need to be fixed I'll work on fixing all known bugs that have been encountered at the moment.

2: Graphical update: Since the beginning I felt as though the cel shaded graphics were somewhat lacking, so since the demo was released I was also working/experimenting with the right materials and I've finally finished.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952336/51c7bd31a9a6a641e173ea547f8e747b51d44985.gif[/img]

This will only be affecting player characters and certain npcs, therefore visual quality with reflections won't be gone aswell. 

3: Cutscene Images: With this update I won't be doing hand-drawn cutscenes (since it'll take to long) instead with the new graphical update I'll be making scenes out of those.

4: Second Arc: Finally I'll be releasing the next arc. I'll discuss all the additional content later but expect new characters, weapons, bosses, and mechanics.

That's all for now, see you out there~

notes.title: Pre-Launch Update
notes.notes:
~These fixes are for both the demo build and will be implemented into the full version.

-Dusk Counter on perfect dodge has been increased from 1 to 3 seconds

-Increased mobility on most Left and Right Weapon skills, aswell as Artemis Heat Skills

-Improved Stagger mechanic

-Added Codex

-Fixed enemy hp bug
This bug was doubling enemy hp, but due to it going unnoticed gameplay was balanced with this in mind so overall every enemy has lost 75% hp.

-Fixed currency not saving

-Added in combat attire for units, aswell as made improved the character models

-Lowered the size of VFX on certain ranged weapons

-Condensed subsystem amount for cleaner UI and a less intense feel
Subsystem UI was always abit too much, so I've condensed it to only list the important ones.

notes.title: 10/11/22 Small Update
notes.notes:
[b]This update is for the demo build which includes:[/b]

-Improvements to the tutorial, aswell as an option for replaying said tutorial. This also includes explanations for using the subsystem menu, how dialogue works, and the codex system.

-Indicators to represent dialogue that has not been seen yet

-The codex, (that isn't fully implemented yet) although it cannot be accessed atm.

Next update will most likely be the last for the demo, and it will most likely stay the same unless something happens once Grave Queen releases. Anywho, next update is focused on updating playable character models and completing the codex system.
